name: theme-vector-grid
description: Reel theme: vector grid. Built on herk-edit-kit (HyperFrames + GSAP) instead of Remotion. Dark graph paper with teal as the concept color, red for the wrong way and green for the payoff. Hard-cut layouts (split, full graphic, full face, punch-in), one stage of 1080x880 sub-compositions, kit-style boxed captions with Abril Fatface accents. Parts: key-value cache table with HIT/MISS pills, paraphrase grid, embedding vector strip, 2D vector space with clusters, similarity meter with threshold, latency race lanes, bloom filter bits, TTL bars, policy version card, summary chips.
